then.say: Oh! A visitor. Brother Cuthwin, novice. I sweep the porch. The Prior says a clean porch is a clean soul.
The wax keeps dripping, though. I sweep it and it's back by morning. Maybe my soul's the problem.

do.say: The brothers inside don't talk much any more. They just stand where they stood and burn.
I'm not allowed past the courtyard yet. I'm starting to think that's a mercy.
Hobb. He was a bell-ringer, once. Now he rings his bowl. I give him my bread. Don't tell the Prior.

then.say: It's stopped dripping. For the first time since I came. I don't know what to sweep.

else.say: Wipe your feet. Please. I've only just done there.
